# playwright-slack-report

> A TypeScript package that publishes Playwright test summaries to Slack through a bot or incoming webhook. Use it as a Playwright reporter or as a CLI consuming Playwright JSON results.

This file is the repository's concise entry point for LLMs. Links are relative to the repository root. Read the linked source for exact behavior and defaults; README examples may differ from the current implementation. The project is MIT licensed, builds CommonJS JavaScript and TypeScript declarations into `dist/`, and uses Playwright Test for its test suite.

Use the Bun version pinned in `.bun-version`. Install with `bun install --frozen-lockfile`; run `bun run build`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, and `bun test`. Run `bun run test:coverage` for all-source Istanbul statement, branch, function, and line coverage, including subprocesses, with LCOV output for Coveralls. Root, harness, and website dependencies have separate `bun.lock` files. The Bun-driven package consumer harness requires Node 24+ for the installed consumer: `bun run harness:offline` validates packaging, CLI, lifecycle reporting, and browser outcomes without Slack traffic. `bun run harness` exercises live delivery and proxies. Published consumers still use their existing Node/npm/Yarn workflows. Releases retain `npm publish --provenance`.

The installed reporter entry point is `playwright-slack-report/dist/src/SlackReporter.js`. Reporter options include `channels`, `onSuccessChannels`, `onFailureChannels`, `sendResults` (`always`, `on-failure`, or `off`), `slackOAuthToken`, `slackWebHookUrl`, `layout`, `layoutAsync`, `maxNumberOfFailuresToShow`, `meta`, `disableUnfurl`, `showInThread`, `sendCustomBlocksInThreadAfterIndex`, and `proxy`. Bot authentication can use `SLACK_BOT_USER_OAUTH_TOKEN`. Webhooks do not support failure threads or custom blocks in threads.

The CLI takes a separate JSON configuration and a Playwright JSON report: `npx playwright-slack-report --config cli_config.json --json-results merged_tests_results.json`. Both file arguments are required. Generate merged input with `npx playwright merge-reports --reporter json ./all-blob-reports > merged_tests_results.json`. CLI configuration requires `sendResults` (`always` or `on-failure`), `slackLogLevel`, and exactly one of `sendUsingBot` or `sendUsingWebhook`. CLI option names include `maxNumberOfFailures`, `customLayout`, and `customLayoutAsync`, unlike the reporter's corresponding names. CLI metadata values beginning with `__ENV_` resolve environment variables, for example `__ENV_BUILD_ID` reads `BUILD_ID`.

Custom layouts receive `SummaryResults` and return Slack Block Kit blocks, synchronously or asynchronously. Keep live-reporter and JSON-parser outcome handling consistent, including retries, flaky tests, expected failures, unexpected passes, and skipped tests. Edit source files rather than generated `dist/` output. Keep Slack tokens, webhook URLs, and local `.env` files out of commits and diagnostics. Live harness runs post real Slack messages; bot reports are cleaned up, while webhook reports remain.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Installation, reporter and CLI configuration, Slack setup, custom layouts, and contribution examples.
- [Consumer harness guide](harness/README.md): Offline and live execution, prerequisites, outcome checks, proxy coverage, cleanup, and diagnostics.
- [Package manifest](package.json): Dependency versions, build/test scripts, published files, and executable entry point.
- [License](LICENSE): MIT license terms.

## Implementation

- [Playwright reporter](src/SlackReporter.ts): Reporter lifecycle, configuration, outcome collection, authentication, proxy setup, and delivery selection.
- [CLI](cli.ts): Command arguments, JSON report processing, metadata substitution, layout loading, and Slack delivery.
- [CLI schema](src/cli/cli_schema.ts): Zod validation, CLI option types, accepted values, and defaults.
- [CLI prechecks](src/cli/cli_pre_checks.ts): File checks, configuration validation, transport exclusivity, and webhook/thread restrictions.
- [Results parser](src/ResultsParser.ts): Live test results and JSON report parsing, summary counts, retry handling, and failure details.
- [Shared types](src/index.ts): `SummaryResults`, metadata, failures, and Playwright JSON report structures.
- [Bot client](src/SlackClient.ts): Bot message generation, channel delivery, and threading.
- [Webhook client](src/SlackWebhookClient.ts): Incoming webhook message generation and delivery.
- [Layout generator](src/LayoutGenerator.ts): Default Slack summary and failure blocks.

## Verification

- [Bun configuration](bunfig.toml): Unit test directory, setup, and development runtime.
- [Parser tests](tests/ResultsParser.spec.ts): Summary and outcome parsing expectations.
- [Reporter tests](tests/SlackReporter.spec.ts): Reporter configuration and lifecycle expectations.
- [Bot delivery tests](tests/SlackClient_send_message.spec.ts): Bot sending and thread behavior.
- [Bot layout tests](tests/SlackClient_generate_blocks.spec.ts): Generated Slack blocks.
- [Webhook tests](tests/SlackWehookClient.spec.ts): Webhook behavior; the filename intentionally matches the repository spelling.
- [CLI precheck tests](tests/cli_prechecks.spec.ts): Valid and invalid CLI inputs.
- [CLI retry/thread tests](tests/CLI_RetryThreading.spec.ts): CLI retry summaries and failure threading.
- [Proxy tests](tests/ProxyConfiguration.spec.ts): Reporter and CLI proxy behavior.
- [Harness runner](harness/run.mjs): Build, pack, isolated installation, browser scenarios, Slack verification, and cleanup.
- [Test workflow](.github/workflows/playwright.yml): CI lint, TypeScript compilation, tests, and coverage.
- [Harness workflow](.github/workflows/harness.yml): Packaged consumer integration checks in CI.

## Optional

- [Simple layout example](custom_block/simple.ts): Minimal custom summary layout.
- [Metadata layout example](custom_block/simple_with_meta.ts): Custom layout including metadata.
- [CLI layout example](custom_block/cli_block_with_meta.ts): CLI-compatible exported layout functions.
- [TypeScript configuration](tsconfig.json): Compiler settings and output directory.
- [ESLint configuration](eslint.config.js): Source lint rules.
- [Harness environment template](harness/.env.example): Names of live harness configuration variables.
